name: PT Bank CIMB Niaga Tbk Class A
summary: PT Bank CIMB Niaga Tbk provides various banking products and services to small to medium enterprises, individuals, and corporate customers in Indonesia and internationally. The company operates through Corporate, Business, Retail, Treasury, and Sharia segments. It offers consumer banking products and services, including mortgage, auto, and personal loans, as well as partnership vehicle ownership financing; credit and debit cards; wealth management products; general and life bancassurance products; savings products; digital banking services; saving, current, time, and term deposit products; digital banking products and services; treasury products comprising foreign exchange, strike currency, market linked deposits, swap depos and bonds, and mutual fund products. The company also provides business banking products and services comprising working capital, investment, and financing loans; cash management, trade finance, and other bank services; treasury services that include foreign exchange, money market, derivatives, placements investing, securities transactions, and hedging products; and remittance and value chain services. As of December 31, 2020, it operated a network of 451 branches; 4,316 ATMs; 133 cash deposit machines; and 801 cash recycle machines. The company was formerly known as PT Bank Niaga Tbk and changed its name to PT Bank CIMB Niaga Tbk in May 2008. The company was founded in 1955 and is headquartered in Jakarta, Indonesia. PT Bank CIMB Niaga Tbk is a subsidiary of CIMB Group Sdn Bhd.
